changeHypothesis.summary: Mate60/TechInsights confirmed a real domestic advanced-chip capability step, but representative A-share equipment/MEMS/packaging candidates had weak or negative H1 earnings. The news created immediate price moves without a verified company earnings bridge.
changeHypothesis.persistenceReason: Technical capability is durable, but listed-company incidence is uncertain.
disconfirmingEvidence: 长川 H1 profit -91.7% and CFO deeply negative.
赛微 and 通富 were loss-making.
Stock reactions differed widely before any new earnings disclosure.
